# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Fan art

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Fan artists and their art shown on the Art page.

### `GET /api/media/gallery` — List fan art

Auth: optional (`Bearer`)

Returns a page of fan art, as shown on the art gallery page. `page` starts at 1. `pageSize` defaults to 30 and accepts 1 to 200 (values outside that range fall back to 50).

`search` matches the credit, description, file name, tags and artist. `tag` takes one or more tag names separated by spaces, and every tag must match. `artistId` limits results to one artist (IDs come from `GET /api/media/artists?loadArts=false`). `hideWebM=true` leaves out animated WebM files.

`sort` accepts `newest` (the default), `oldest`, `score_desc` or `score_asc`.

The response has `items`, `totalCount`, `page` and `pageSize`.

Authentication is optional. When a bearer token is supplied, the request is associated with that user.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |
| `pageSize` | query | `int` | no | default: 30 |
| `search` | query | `string` | no | default: "" |
| `tag` | query | `string` | no | default: "" |
| `artistId` | query | `string` | no | default: "" |
| `hideWebM` | query | `bool` | no | default: false |
| `sort` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK

### `GET /api/media/artists` — List fan artists

Auth: optional (`Bearer`)

Returns every fan artist. With `loadArts=true` (the default), each artist also includes all of their art.

**Large payload:** with `loadArts=true` the response contains every artwork on the site and can be several megabytes. Pass `loadArts=false` when you only need the artist list.

Authentication is optional. When a bearer token is supplied, the request is associated with that user.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loadArts` | query | `bool` | no | default: true |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id?: string | null
  name?: string | null
  socialLink?: string | null
  userId?: string | null
  arts?: {
    id?: string | null
    fileName?: string | null
    contentType?: string | null
    description?: string | null
    isAnimated?: bool
    credit?: string | null
    cloudflareId?: string | null
    mediaStorageType?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath?: string | null
    artist?: object
    upvotes?: int
    tagString?: string | null
    mediaTag?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }[] | null
}[]
```
